requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: May the two players interleave Gather and Damage?

fact_assessments.expected: One player must finish the full Gather-and-Damage instruction sequence before the next starts; the proposed interleaving is not allowed.
fact_assessments.observed: For each player, one player follows all instructions, then the next; thus A finishes Gather and Damage before B performs theirs.

summary_support.text: For “each player,” one player follows all instructions, then the next;

grades.reason: Both the ruling and quotation require completion of one player’s Gather and Damage before the next player; the proposed interleaving is excluded. Choosing the first player is unasked background.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Cleanup or outcome check first?

fact_assessments.expected: Correct the illegal position after the completed action tree but before checking victory/defeat; check the cleaned-up state.
fact_assessments.observed: Correct the illegal placement before outcome check: after primary and triggered actions, clean the human to the nearest legal land before checking outcomes. That cleanup is not a move/action and triggers nothing.

summary_support.text: **After the primary action and all triggered actions finish**, remaining illegal humans are cleaned up to the nearest legal land.
Cleanup is not an action, move, removal or destruction and triggers nothing, and occurs before the outcome check.

grades.reason: Places cleanup after the action tree and before the outcome check. Nearest-land/non-action details are correct background, not additional requirements.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: When the Fast threshold is applied

fact_assessments.expected: Apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Innate's Speed/phase, before its ordinary effects rather than waiting until ordinary effect resolution.
fact_assessments.observed: Apply a threshold changing Speed before ordinary effects, when checking that attribute; Thunderspeaker’s met Fast threshold therefore permits using its Innate in Fast.

summary_support.text: Apply a threshold changing Speed, Range or targeting when checking that attribute, before the ordinary effects: for example, Thunderspeaker's met Fast threshold permits using its Innate in Fast.

grades.reason: Applies the Speed threshold at the attribute/phase check before ordinary effects, permitting the stipulated Fast use.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Source and real-versus-nightmare Damage

fact_assessments.expected: The delayed trigger remains Bringer's Power, follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths and deals hypothetical rather than real Damage; the other Spirit causing the trigger does not take ownership.
fact_assessments.observed: It still belongs to the Spirit that used Vengeance. If Bringer used it, its triggered Damage follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths even when another Spirit caused the triggering destruction.

summary_support.text: The triggered effect still belongs to the Spirit that used Vengeance: if Bringer used it, its later Damage follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths even when another Spirit's action caused the triggering destruction.
Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence.

grades.reason: Explicitly retains Bringer’s ownership and applies To Dream a Thousand Deaths despite the other Spirit triggering it. In this binary question, naming that rule resolves hypothetical rather than real Damage; no separate Fear-value recital is requested.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Does the Ravage payment cover the later Build?

fact_assessments.expected: No; the first payment skips only the Ravage, not the later Build.
fact_assessments.observed: The first use skips only the Ravage. The later Build requires a fresh decision and another Presence disk; with three initially, Green has two remaining after the first payment, so the Sacred Site still exists and the second use can skip Build, ending with one Presence.

summary_support.text: Each use skips just that Ravage or Build action and costs one of Green's Presence in its Sacred Site there.
A later Build needs a fresh decision and another disk: starting with three, Green may skip the Ravage, retain a two-disk Sacred Site, then skip the Build and end with one disk.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Decision and cost for the later Build

fact_assessments.expected: Skipping the later Build requires a fresh optional choice and another of Green's Presence destroyed in that land.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: May adjacent own Presence be lost?

fact_assessments.expected: Yes; Sworn to Victory can require Thunderspeaker's adjacent Presence, rather than being confined to the ravaged land.
fact_assessments.observed: Yes. It destroys one of Thunderspeaker’s Presence within Range 1 of the Ravaged land, so an adjacent disk qualifies even when Thunderspeaker has no Presence in the ravaged land.

summary_support.text: **For each destroyed Dahan, Thunderspeaker destroys one of its own Presence within Range 1 of the Ravaged land**, even if no Blight was added.

grades.reason: Allows Thunderspeaker’s adjacent own Presence to be destroyed under the Range-1 rule. Timing and per-Dahan multiplier are correct background rather than separate requested parts.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Which Defend travels?

fact_assessments.expected: Only the fixed Trees and Stones Defend 2 travels with that Dahan; Words of Warning's separate Defend 3 does not travel.

summary_support.text: Only this Power's Defend 2 per pushed Dahan travels; separate Defend from another effect, such as Words of Warning, stays in its original land.

grades.reason: Only Trees and Stones’ fixed Defend 2 travels; the separate Words of Warning Defend 3 stays. Attack timing was not asked.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Use all 14 or treat one as spare?

fact_assessments.expected: Use 13 Presence of that color; the extra disk is a spare and is not available for setup or later gameplay.
fact_assessments.observed: One accidental extra Presence disk is a spare, not additional Presence for play; use the normal 13.

grades.reason: Treats the extra disk as a spare, with 13 usable for setup/play. The attached setup quotation explicitly supplies the normal count even where prose is brief.
